english.note: Use this when you want to emphasize an approximate degree of probability or uncertainty.
Use this for a probable guess when sounding somewhat less definite than 應該.

examples.english: We will presumably only get back at around eight.
examples.jyutping: daai6 koi3 baat3 dim2 sin1 faan2 dou3

examples.english: I will probably get back around three.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 koi3 saam1 dim2 sin1 faan1 dou3
